lines.text: So? The exam! How did it go? Don't make me guess, {player}.
You had that exam, didn't you? I've been wondering all week. Tell me.
I kept my fingers crossed through the whole exam morning. Did it work?
You're back! How was the mission? All in one piece, I see. Mostly.
I heard your squad came in through the gate. How did the mission go?
You said you were heading out on a mission. I watched the road until I heard you were home. How was it?
How was the festival? Did you win anything at the stalls? Eat anything ridiculous?
You went to the festival, didn't you? Tell me about the lanterns. I missed half of it.
I looked for you at the festival but the crowds were too thick. Did you have fun?
How's the training coming along? Did you get that move you were stuck on?
You said you'd be training hard this week. Show me your hands. Ha, blisters. Good.
So, did all that training pay off, or are you just more bruised?
Well? How did the evening go? You can't just tell me about it and then not tell me!
You had that evening out planned. I want every detail. The good ones, anyway.
So? Did you have a nice time with them? You're smiling. That's an answer.
We haven't had our ramen in ages. The stool at the end has gone cold. Tonight?
Our dango afternoons stopped, {player}. The tea house keeps asking where you've been.
It's been weeks since our barbecue night. The grill misses us. So do I.
We haven't sparred in a month. I'm getting soft. Help me fix that?
Training Ground 3's been lonely without our sessions. Same time as before?
The fish are biting at dawn again and nobody's sitting in your spot. Come back to the river?
I went up the Rock alone last night. The stars were fine. Not as good without you naming them wrong.
My brushes are drying out. We used to paint at the overlook. Shall we, again?
The shogi board's gathering dust. I've been practising alone, so be warned.
I still save the table by the window at the library, out of habit. Come back and use it.
I walked the market alone last week. Bought nothing. It's no fun without you haggling.
Nobody's raced me over the rooftops in weeks. I'm winning by default. That's no way to win.
The bathhouse keeper asked after you. I said you'd gone soft. Prove me wrong?
I've been ringing the shrine bell alone lately. It sounds thinner. Come with me again?
The dog keeps stopping at the corner where we used to meet you. Walk with us again?
There's been an empty place at my table for a month. It's yours. Come back to dinner.
The blossoms won't wait for us forever. Will you come and see them again before they fall?
The lake's still warm. Our swims stopped. Let's not waste the rest of the summer.
The moon's been full twice since we last watched it together. Let's not miss a third.
There's fresh snow and no one to throw it at. You know what that means.
I walked by the river alone last evening. It was too quiet. I'd like our walks back.
I haven't sent a lantern out on the lake since we stopped going. I've been saving one for us.
My mum keeps asking when you're coming back for dinner. You should come back!
